scope: Public customer-side APIs for self-operated resource pools. Service ownership metadata determines scope, not product-specific Type I/II version names. No authenticated cloud execution was used.

updates.change: Add a self-operated VM purchase price query. Update order form encoding, inputs and resource result fields.
Refresh documented filters and group configuration inputs.
Remove network name inputs from application creation after their removal from the request contract.
Add node flavor and supported data-disk type queries.
Accept cluster label maps and update fleet, IPv6 and channel inputs.
Send the disaster recovery server detail identifiers as query parameters and read records from the top-level returnObj array.
Add workflow schedule creation, retrieval, listing, updates and deletion. Support enterprise-project filters and workflow qualifiers, and read execution lists from the current response envelope.
List database table structures for a selected cluster.
Clarify the load-balancer and public-IP deletion options during instance unsubscription.
Expose automatic renewal status during instance creation.
Add four v4.2 alarm-rule commands and align existing alarm-rule input requirements and types.
Support asynchronous and batch repository deletion. Expose namespace and repository states and add bounded waits for ACTIVE on image and chart detail commands.
Expose host status, flavor, architecture and sorting inputs and host allocation fields.
Expose the documented ID input for the MySQL permission query.
Add enterprise-project filtering and project IDs to image listing and refresh instance input descriptions.
Refresh instance creation input descriptions.
Add desktop, time and power policy commands, resource-pack price queries and desktop firewall group, policy and ACL management.
Update flavor inputs and local disk fields, accept the documented policy ID string and link CPU history help to the current monitoring command.
Refresh the historical monitoring query input description.
Refresh dedicated load balancer creation input guidance.
Add 19 event bus, rule, source and stream commands and four bounded running-state waiters.
Refresh volume creation and attachment input guidance.
Make the fuzzy file-system name filter optional and update cluster list output for the current response envelope.
Add subject authorization and enterprise-project access commands and update user security inputs.
Refresh image detail and sharing input guidance.
Add the instance capacity check and document the four retained fault-drill routes. Both v2 retrieval APIs remain published.
Accept the unit code when retrieving download URLs.
Require the documented region code when listing environments.
Add subdirectory quota management, a bounded wait for quota activation and file-system tag update and lookup commands.
Refresh metric selection guidance and the host type requirement for instance creation.
Expose the instance creation ID input and add labels, time zone, enterprise project and VPC fields to instance listing.
Use node names for the updated node operation and refresh audit download help and flavor result fields.
Add development-machine storage updates and SSH configuration for computing jobs.
Refresh file-system and permission command inputs and captured response examples.
Wait for a network path analysis to finish or report an error on either supported detail query.
Refresh bucket, replication, retention and multipart upload input guidance.
